reviewSummary: Card-based redesign following explicit user brief: rounded rectangular containers, gradient borders, shallow shadows, grid-lined signal plots, operator illumination, and smooth nested predictive intervals. First card draft rejected for extra sum-to-plot bypass; second removes it. Reviewed four incoming sum contributions and a single outgoing conversion/sorting -> floors -> plot route, history endpoints, context tags, gate and five quantiles. Signals remain illustrative. Native built-in image_gen used directly, not the unavailable codex-image2 bridge. Subjective review score, not external certification or user approval. PNG is raster; PDF/SVG exports contain the raster. Prompt and refinement saved in prompt_cards_v1.txt and refinement_cards_v2.txt.
